name: CQXYM Count Permutations
justification: Beautiful symmetry argument gives (2n)!/2; statement is a bit verbose and needs modular factorials.
solution_sketch: Reversing a permutation of length 2n maps k ascents to 2n-1-k, pairing 'ascents >= n' with 'ascents < n' bijectively. Exactly half of all (2n)! permutations qualify: answer = (2n)!/2 mod 1e9+7 (precompute factorials).
